question: How many of the 911 detected family-result rows resolve uniquely, ambiguously, or not at all against all tracked family manifests?
nonDuplication: ETT-023 established that outcomes exist but rows lack embedded namespace fields. This follow-up measures whether manifest identity can be reconstructed without unsafe filename or last-write fallback.

sampleSelection.rule: all F-prefixed rows in tracked reports/logs JSON joined by exact variant ID to all variants in 161 tracked family manifests

primaryOutcome: unique, ambiguous, and unmatched row counts
secondaryOutcomes: up to 25 ambiguity examples with candidate edges
stoppingRule: one global exact-ID join; do not apply filename/context heuristics and do not solve
escalationRule: only globally unique rows may enter a mechanical migration; ambiguous/unmatched rows require authenticated context or exclusion before boundary aggregation
